snippet.description:

Gameplay Trailer #3 shows more of the current encounters of modern battlfield in Cobra Strike with old and brand new tech, and how to counter them. So watch your vectors and stay tune!

The '90s call for your duty! Relive the Strike! Ready for action? 💥🚁🎮
